answer: Bank-verified onboarding stops Sybil attacks. Step one: the agent submits a real bank account number. Step two: the registry sends 4-cent and 11-cent deposits into the ocean of bank traffic. Step three: in 72 hours the agent reports the amounts. Only the true owner sees them. Cost per fake identity: one account, 45 minutes at a branch, a 25 dollar minimum balance. A falcon check runs on each: a human re-reads name mismatches the same day, killing bought accounts at step one. Approvals leave one sable entry in the public log; reused accounts are rejected.
